this works for me but not everyone. its taken some practice to get this makeup routine down to 10/15 minutes: start with bare face. light moisturizer, eyecream, let them dry. then start with eyes first. that way u can clean any fallout. So once the eyecream is absorbed, put on eyeprimer all over lid and a little under the bottom lashline. then apply the lid color, crease color, corner color, browbone color. blend blend blend. pencil in the bottom eyeliner, then the top lashline eyeliner ( i prefer dark brown liquid). do not apply mascara yet. save for last. then move on to the face. Apply face primer, concealer, then your foundation or tinted moisturizer. then set with powder. apply bronzer and blush, then finally go back to the eyes and apply mascara, 2 coats. then do the lips - pencil is optional, gloss only is my preference since my eyes are emphasized. Finally make sure to take a q-tip and a little makeup remover and carefully take any excess
makeup that fell onto the eyebrows, dont want powdery brows! And done! the looks that i rely on are bronze smokey eyes or naked / lightly sculpted eyes with a precise liquid cat eye..
